versions.content: {DRAFT} The EthTrcv shall collect the information of the Eth Swt Ports referring to the each EthTrcv instance (e.g. TrcvIdx) during configuration in order to call the EthSwt callbacks of MKA (e.g. EthSwt_MacSecUpdateSecYIndication, EthSwt_MacSecAddTxSaNotification, EthSwt_MacSecAddRxSaNotification and Eth Swt_MacSecGetMacSecStatsNotification). The EthSwtPort.EthSwtPortTrcvRef links an EthSwtPort to an EthTrcvIdx in the EthSwt configuration.
